project_name: Madhushri & Bharath Royal Palace Wedding Invitation
archetype: LUXURY & ROYAL HERITAGE (Archetype 5 + Custom Royal Indian Palace)
key_features: Full-screen 3D Palace Entrance with Hinged Teakwood Doors, Brass Accents, Diya Glow & Particle Dust
Cinematic Royal Invitation Reveal with Silk-Maroon Texture & Rotating Gold Mandala
Two-Day Celebrations Chapter (05 Dec Wedding & 06 Dec Grand Reception) with Editable Cards
Venue Details & Interactive Map Placeholder with Editable Addresses
Cinematic Editorial Asymmetrical Gallery with Lightbox & Hover Zoom
Interactive RSVP Form with Guest Count, Meal/Seating Preference, and Wishes
Smooth Scroll (Lenis), Framer Motion Entrance Animations, and WebGL Fallback

accessibility_and_testing.data_testid_convention: kebab-case role-based testids on all interactive and key informational elements
accessibility_and_testing.reduced_motion: Supported via CSS media queries and conditional Framer Motion states
accessibility_and_testing.contrast: WCAG AA compliant gold/ivory text on deep imperial burgundy and royal maroon backgrounds
